play.message: Synthetic EventSystem pointer tests in actual SampleScene; isolated presentation state, no native OS mouse injection.
checks: body click completes typewriter without skipping
body child click advances exactly one line
right click and drag do not advance
reminder panel and Next clicks do not reveal or dismiss text
reminder timer not shortened by clicks
reminder timed return preserves original line
action guide has no click progression or blocking panel
action guide click cannot complete objective
pre-reveal reminder also ignores pointer advance
existing Space progression entry can still dismiss reminder
